name: WBS — Trade Fair Assistant — WF-B Lead Processing

nodes.name: Claim One Lead
nodes.notes: One lead per execution. Claim uses SKIP LOCKED and a 5-minute lease; no HTTP call holds a database transaction.

nodes.name: Research Company
nodes.notes: Select a separate Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <provider API key>. Fixed provider host; no redirects, no automatic node retry. Both outputs are validated.

nodes.name: Extract Meeting Notes
nodes.notes: Select a separate Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <provider API key>. Fixed provider host; no redirects, no automatic node retry. Both outputs are validated.

nodes.name: Persist Result and Email Outbox
nodes.notes: Atomic result + outbox + completed status. If database becomes unavailable, the lease expires and a future run recovers the lead. No external email call occurs here.

nodes.name: Record Processing Failure
nodes.notes: Only bounded error codes are persisted. Raw provider errors, notes and credentials are not logged.
